law_categories.title: Family Law
law_categories.short_desc: Compassionate counsel for divorce, child custody, alimony, and adoption proceedings.
law_categories.full_desc: Family law covers sensitive and life-altering legal matters involving familial relationships. Our dedicated attorneys specialize in navigating divorce settlements, custody battles, marital agreements, and child support hearings with confidentiality and empathy.
law_categories.key_services: Divorce Mediation, Child Custody & Visitation, Alimony Support, Prenuptial Agreements, Guardianship & Adoption

law_categories.title: Criminal Law
law_categories.short_desc: Relentless defense for misdemeanors, felonies, DUI/DWIs, and white-collar defense.
law_categories.full_desc: Facing criminal accusations requires immediate, strategic defense counsel. We protect your constitutional rights, challenge prosecutorial overreach, investigate state evidence, and represent you at trial or settlement negotiation.
law_categories.key_services: Felony & Misdemeanor Defense, White-Collar Crimes, DUI/Traffic Offenses, Bail & Bond Hearings, Record Expungement

law_categories.title: Real Estate Law
law_categories.short_desc: Guidance for commercial & residential transactions, lease disputes, and zoning issues.
law_categories.full_desc: Whether purchasing real property, structuring a commercial lease, or dealing with title encumbrances, our property attorneys protect high-value assets and ensure regulatory compliance in transactions.
law_categories.key_services: Property Purchase Closings, Commercial Leases, Title Deeds & Liens, Boundary Disputes, Zoning & Land Use

law_categories.title: Employment Law
law_categories.short_desc: Advocacy for wrongful termination, workplace harassment, wage disputes, and severance.
law_categories.full_desc: Both employees and employers navigate an intricate web of federal and state labor statutes. We provide representation in wrongful termination, FLSA wage theft, discrimination, and non-compete agreements.
law_categories.key_services: Wrongful Termination, Sexual Harassment & Discrimination, Wage & Hour Claims, Severance Review, Non-Compete Clauses

law_categories.title: Business Law
law_categories.short_desc: Corporate formation, governance, contract drafting, mergers, and intellectual property.
law_categories.full_desc: From early-stage entity structuring to complex enterprise litigation and mergers & acquisitions, we serve as outside general counsel for businesses of all scales.
law_categories.key_services: LLC/Corp Formation, Contract Negotiation, IP & Trademark Licensing, M&A Advisory, Commercial Litigation

law_categories.title: Personal Injury Law
law_categories.short_desc: Maximizing compensation for vehicular accidents, medical malpractice, and slip & falls.
law_categories.full_desc: When negligence injures you or your family, you deserve aggressive advocacy against insurance firms. We secure damages for medical bills, pain and suffering, and lost income.
law_categories.key_services: Auto & Truck Collisions, Medical Malpractice, Slip and Fall Claims, Product Liability, Wrongful Death
